title: Bolsista Mestre - Grupo Boticário - Futuro da Beleza - Vaga Afirmativa Para Talentos Diversos | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I.   • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.

Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
  • Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.

Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.

Habilidades:

  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição via cartão Ifood Benefícios.
  • Ajuda de custo ou vale transporte via Ifood Benefícios.
  • Assistência médica (coparticipativa, extensiva à dependentes)
  • Assistência odontológica (extensiva à dependentes)
  • Day off e mimo no aniversário.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Licença maternidade estendida.
  • Espaço interativo com videogame.
  • Espaço de descompressão #DESLIGUER.
  • Frutas todos os dias
  • Estacionamento.
  • Treinamentos constantes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.

  • Residir em Campinas/SP e região ou disponibilidade de mudança para Campinas.

Saúde Ocupacional (Health)

  • Apoiar a elaboração e execução do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO), em parceria com o médico do trabalho.
  • Monitorar e incentivar campanhas de vacinação, ergonomia, exames periódicos e programas de promoção à saúde e bem-estar.

Relacionamento com Stakeholders

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You'll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You'll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix's collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil's legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you'll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that's just the beginning - here's what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you're well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

You're comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don't interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.

Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.

  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.

Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

title: Técnico de Manutenção Predial
description:
RESUMO DO TRABALHO:

Realiza tarefas técnicas, elétricas e mecânicas, incluindo instalação, reparo, manutenção preventiva, solução de problemas e melhorias de processos em instalações existentes e futuras. Além disso, o técnico de manutenção trabalhará na conservação das áreas externas, áreas comuns e áreas de produção para manter o padrão da empresa de ambientes limpos e seguros.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Trabalhar com o Gerente de Manutenção para desenvolver cronogramas padrão de manutenção preventiva.

• Operar, reparar e manter equipamentos de produção, equipamentos de movimentação de materiais, sistemas elétricos e mecânicos, incluindo, mas não limitado a sistemas e equipamentos de sprinklers contra incêndio.

• Substituir peças defeituosas como engrenagens, embreagens, buchas, eixos, rolamentos, solenóides, válvulas, bombas, controles de direção, etc.

• Executar manutenção de rotina em todas as máquinas da planta e demais áreas do prédio e da propriedade conforme instruções do gerente de operações.

• Executar corretamente os procedimentos de Bloqueio e Etiquetagem (Lockout Tagout) e manter atenção constante à segurança.

• Utilizar ferramentas elétricas e manuais para realizar diversas tarefas, incluindo reparo de máquinas, montagem de tubulação, manutenção elétrica e eletrônica.

• Operar empilhadeiras, carrinhos e outros equipamentos básicos de carga e descarga, quando necessário.

• Fazer a lubrificação, engraxamento e abastecimento dos equipamentos conforme necessário.

• Completar procedimentos rotineiros de manutenção preventiva conforme estabelecido no Manual de Políticas e Procedimentos.

• Apoiar programas de redução de custos e controle de despesas, priorizando consertar ao invés de substituir peças, evitando desperdícios de materiais e suprimentos, e utilizando corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos.

CONHECIMENTOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES BÁSICAS:

• Capacidade comprovada de aplicar princípios de raciocínio lógico para identificar e corrigir problemas.

• Capacidade comprovada de ler, escrever e se comunicar de forma eficaz.

• Habilidade para operar equipamentos básicos de escritório como copiadoras, fax, calculadoras, máquinas de postagem e sistemas telefônicos multilinha.

• Ensino Médio completo, GED ou experiência e/ou treinamento relacionado.

EXIGÊNCIAS FÍSICAS:

• Deve ser capaz de ficar em pé, caminhar e/ou sentar por longos períodos, além de dobrar-se, agachar, subir escadas, alcançar, carregar objetos e rastejar em áreas confinadas.

• Deve ter capacidade para trabalhar em áreas internas e externas em todas as condições climáticas (chuva, neve, calor, granizo, vento e gelo).

• Deve ser capaz de empurrar, puxar, levantar, carregar ou manusear pesos de até 11 kg sozinho e até 23 kg com ajuda.

• Deve ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo sobreaviso durante noites, fins de semana e feriados.

title: Technical Solution Engineer - Sao Paulo
description:
About CATL

CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy!

CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years.

Job Description

ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications
  • Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities
  • Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs
  • Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user's manual, disposal proposal, etc.,
  • Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise
  • Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement
  • Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed
  • Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs

Requirements and skills:

  • Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo
  • At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market
  • Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous
  • Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous
  • Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous
  • Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Superb collaboration and communication
  • Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities
  • Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Tax Analyst (Indirect Taxes)
description:

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:

HBX Group is the world's leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We're game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to 'move fast, dream big and make the difference' every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our 'global approach, local touch' mentality. We're headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.

We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers. This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí.

Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.

If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!

Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Analista de crédito sênior
description:
Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI TM, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

A oportunidade

O Analista Financeiro Sênior na área de Crédito é responsável por realizar análises financeiras aprofundadas para embasar decisões de concessão de crédito, monitorar a saúde financeira da carteira de clientes e propor estratégias para mitigação de riscos. Atua como elo entre a área de negócios e a gestão de riscos, garantindo que as operações de crédito estejam alinhadas com as políticas internas e a estratégia da empresa.

O seu impacto

- Elaboração e execução das estratégias de crédito.

- Elaborar e revisar modelos de score de crédito e políticas de concessão.

- Apoiar a definição de limites de crédito e condições comerciais.

- Manter o adequado controle da exposição de crédito da companhia e reportar à alta liderança quaisquer situações que possam causar impacto – interno ou mercado.

- Monitorar tendências macroeconômicas e setoriais que possam impactar o risco de crédito.

- Gestão de carteira de clientes de alta relevância e risco, emissão de relatórios gerenciais e KPIs de acompanhamento.

- Utilização de ferramentas de gestão de comportamento de crédito – CISP e Serasa.

- Interagir com áreas como Jurídico, Comercial, Riscos e Compliance para garantir a integridade das operações.

- Garantir o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos da Cia.

- Atendimento a auditorias externas e internas.

- Preparar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações para comitês de crédito e alta liderança.

- Avançar nos processos de transformação digital, buscando automatizações e melhorias dos processos.

Quem estamos buscando?

- Formação superior completa em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas Afins.

- Experiência sólida em análise de crédito, preferencialmente em instituições financeiras ou grandes empresas.

- Conhecimento avançado em Excel e sistemas de gestão financeira (SAP).

- Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e atenção a detalhes.

- Boa comunicação para interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

- Conhecimento em Power BI/Tableau/ Macro (pode ser um diferencial).

- Espanhol e inglês (podem ser um diferencial).

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school's mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC's mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school's commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world's largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc's Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.

About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support, enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData's data feeds effectively.

We expect East Coast work hours.

As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients' investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have); excellent client-facingcommunication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients' questions).

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: OPERADOR DE PRODUÇÃO C - SAFRA
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.

#VemSerAgropalma

Descrição Breve do Cargo:

Acompanhar o controle de perdas e desempenho de equipamentos e máquinas, verificar necessidade de manutenção e investimentos em equipamentos, cumprir programas de limpeza, organização e qualidade implantados, registrar boletins de processos da área, executar a organização, higiene e limpeza de áreas industriais, prestando auxílio na limpeza da área e de equipamentos, e participar de DDS e ginastica laboral junto aos demais colegas de trabalho realizar atividades extras relacionadas

ao cargo.

Local de Trabalho:

Tailândia/PA

Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos. Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos). Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

description:
Código da vaga: 53999

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Habilidades Principais:

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Especialista Meio Biótico
description:
Pionerismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.

Muito além de uma divulgação de vaga, este é um convite para você fazer parte de uma história pioneira, que une inovação, responsabilidade socioambiental e relevância estratégica no cenário global da mineração de terras raras.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal. Somos corajosos e empreendedores.

Valorizamos a diversidade de histórias, perspectivas e talentos, pois sabemos que é essa pluralidade que fortalece nossa cultura e nos impulsiona a alcançar resultados cada vez mais relevantes. Nesta perspectiva, todas as nossas vagas também estão abertas para PCD`s.

Como você poderá contribuir?

Propondo, acompanhando e realizando análises críticas das atividades relacionadas ao sistema de gestão ambiental e programas atrelados a biodiversidade, com base na legislação e normas regulamentadoras e práticas proativas de mercado (IFC, FSC etc), de forma a garantir a operação, melhoria contínua e o desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio.

A pessoa selecionada será responsável por:

  • Realizar e revisar os monitoramentos ambientais estabelecidos no plano de monitoramento;
  • Coordenar tecnicamente os programas bióticos e de biodiversidade;
  • Ministrar treinamentos, a fim de atender requisitos legais e buscar melhoria contínua e inovação;
  • Realizar avaliação da biodiversidade garantindo a manutenção e melhoria dos habits da região;
  • Acompanhar atividades de supressão, Viveiro de Mudas e PRAD;
  • Acompanhar atividades CETRAS, Herbário e Meliponário e outras instalações ligadas a Biodiversidade;
  • Manter comunicação com órgãos governamentais e não – governamentais no intuito de defender os interesses do negócio;
  • Acompanhar atualizações da legislação ambiental, informando os responsáveis para atendimento a todos requisitos legais;
  • Realizar auditorias ambientais internas, em clientes e fornecedores com foco em biodiversidade;
  • Conduzir os trabalhos relacionados a Plano Diretor de Biodiversidade;
  • Buscar parcerias com instituições afim de desenvolver a pesquisa e iniciativas voltadas a Biodiversidade;
  • Garantir o pleno funcionamento do programa de educação ambiental;
  • Controlar os custos e despesas sobre sua responsabilidade;
  • Integrar os planos, pesquisas e inovações ao tema Biodiversidade junto ao Planejamento e Operação;
  • Influenciar o Planejamento Estratégico com base nos pilares do IFC ligados a Biodiversidade.

Quais os requisitos?

Escolaridade

Superior completo em Engenharia(s), Medicina Veterinária ou Biologia Experiência: mínimo 5 anos na área de meio ambiente;

Desejável: Elaboração e acompanhamento de programas ambientais, Licenciamentos ambientais de grande porte

Somos convictos que o sucesso está diretamente ligado ao bem-estar e ao desenvolvimento das pessoas. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios que vão além do cuidado profissional. Buscamos criar um ambiente equilibrado, que respeite as demandas da organização e, ao mesmo tempo, valorize as necessidades pessoais de cada colaborador. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring – Snowflake Lead Developer (Azure & ADF)

Location: Remote in Brazil

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 7–10 years total experience | 2–3 years hands-on Snowflake

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Snowflake Lead Developer with strong expertise in Azure Data Factory (ADF) and data engineering best practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing and developing scalable data architectures, building ETL/ELT pipelines, and optimizing complex SQL workloads within cloud-based environments.

You will play a key role in leading Snowflake development, implementing data transformation logic, and ensuring high-quality data delivery for analytics and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of data solutions within Snowflake.
  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and IICS (Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and stored procedures (SnowProc, SnowSQL) to support complex business logic and transformations.
  • Write efficient, high-performing SQL queries for data integration and analytics.
  • Collaborate with architects and data engineers to define data architecture and governance standards.
  • Implement robust error handling, monitoring, and logging mechanisms for data pipelines.
  • Support CICD implementation using Git/Bitbucket and Visual Studio for code versioning and deployment.
  • Work closely with onsite teams and provide production support when required.
  • Apply data engineering best practices, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Optional: Utilize Airflow or Control-M for workflow orchestration and scheduling.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–10 years of overall experience in data engineering or BI development.
  • 2–3 years of strong hands-on experience in Snowflake (data architecture, analytics, and development).
  • Mastery of SQL — deep experience writing optimized, complex queries in large-scale environments.
  • Expertise in SnowProc and SnowSQL, including writing Snowflake stored procedures and scripts for transformations.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for orchestrating data pipelines.
  • Proficiency in IICS (Informatica Cloud) for data extraction, transformation, and loading into Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with data integration, modeling, and ETL/ELT best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with CICD pipelines, version control (Git/Bitbucket), and Visual Studio.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours to coordinate with global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Airflow or Control-M for workflow scheduling.
  • Experience working in implementation and support projects.
  • Exposure to data governance, metadata management, or cloud cost optimization.

title: User Interface Designer
description:
VirtualiSurg is a software design company specializing in medical and surgical training. It develops immersive simulators for use by operating room staff. It mobilizes different areas of expertise, including virtual reality, haptic technology and machine learning. VirtualiSurg's team works in a multicultural, international and highly interdisciplinary environment and is looking to expand further.

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative UI Designer with a strong focus on creating engaging and immersive user interfaces for web-based platforms. As a UI Designer, you will play a crucial role in shaping the user experience of our simulations by designing visually stunning and intuitive interfaces that seamlessly blend across different virtual environment. In addition, having experience in UI design for VR is a plus, as you will also be involved with teams creating VR designs and interactions for our simulations.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with the design and development teams to understand project requirements and objectives.
  • Design and develop compelling UI layouts, icons, and assets for web and VR applications
  • Create visually stunning and user-friendly UI designs that enhance the overall user experience and usability of web and VR applications.
  • Prototype and iterate on UI designs, incorporating feedback from the team and users to continually improve the interface.
  • Maintain a consistent design language and style across all UI elements, ensuring brand guidelines and project aesthetics are met.
  • Work closely with developers to implement UI designs and ensure their functionality and responsiveness in web and VR environments.
  • Conduct usability testing and gather user feedback to refine and optimize UI designs for maximum user engagement and satisfaction.
  • Stay updated on the latest trends, tools, and techniques in UI design for VR and web, and apply them effectively to enhance the quality and innovation of the UI.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in UI design, with a focus on web and digital applications. Previous experience in VR design is a plus.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard design and prototyping tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, Figma, or similar software.
  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles, human-computer interaction, and usability testing methodologies.
  • Familiarity with VR platforms, devices, and their specific design considerations.
  • Knowledge of web design principles, including responsive design, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Background with Game Engines like Unity 3D is a plus

Equal Opportunity and diversity

VirtualiSurg is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Diversity, multiculturalism and multidisciplinary are key pillars of our recruitment strategy. We consider this to be an important asset for innovating and creating technological breakthroughs. Passion, empathy and the quest for meaning are values shared by our team members. We build fantastic XR simulations thanks to a close-knit team that breaks boundaries through enthusiasm and determination.

title: Plant Manager. Cabo de Santo Agostinho. PLASTICS TRANSFORMATION PROCESSES
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin Brazil: Where purpose comes to life.

You're purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia's Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose 'to advance life around the world' drives our entire global team.

Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it's facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for "good enough" when there's an opportunity to make life better.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It's time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!

We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to join us at Cabo de Santo Agostinho, Pernambuco, Brazil, in the Suape industrial complex . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

About the role:

The plant manager is responsible for managing the daily operations of the plant. This includes planning and coordinating production activities, managing a team of production department heads, supervisors and workers, and ensuring that the plant operates safely and efficiently. The production plant manager will also be responsible for controlling plant costs, improving production efficiency, and establishing and maintaining relationships with suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee plant operations such as budget, production schedule and stock.
  • Analyze production costs and inventory to establish areas for improvements
  • Ensure adherence to rules and workplace policies and HSE.
  • Lead improvement initiatives as aligned with global guidance , such as Lean and Operational Excellence, and other projects to improve quality, reduce costs, improve OEE, save time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or relevant field. (Nice to have: Lean Six Sigma certification)
  • 5+ years of experience in field as a Plan Manager in manufacturing (in Plastic transformation processes).
  • Professional English level (is a key requirement), the interviews will be in English
  • Experience in plant management and manufacturing operations, budget, Strong communication, management and supervisory skills.
  • The candidate will also have an ability to follow safety and compliance guidelines diligently in order to create a healthy work environment for all employees.

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia's Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it's to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: Linguistics Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.

Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.

Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:
  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify

Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test
